mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month change in the consumer price index above 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 12m MA.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, reducing household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, supply chain bottlenecks and reduced manufacturing output signal a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
